Hello! Your art is amazing, you are so skilled!
I would love to commission you for an illustration for my twitch, prints, etc! I have attached references!
I would like a 16:9 illustration of my model. She is a ghost girl. She has green eyes, pale skin, long black hair, dark undereye circles, and fangs! Her personality is smug and gloomy. The character is inspired by Yamamura Sadako.

In the references I have attached the character images and pose composition I would like. Additionally, I added the background but it doesn't have to be very detailed. Make the background what you would like! 
I am generally looking for something sexy, a pose with clawed hands, the character's attention to the viewer with a smug, seductive smile and expression, and breath clouds around her mouth/face.

Thank you for the opportunity, I hope you accept my request!

https://imgur.com/a/oQJaZsC
